heading: Definitions
lead: In sections 698u to 698u–7 of this title:

tree.heading: Advisory Committee
tree.text: The term “Advisory Committee” means the Advisory Committee established under section 698u–5 of this title.

tree.heading: Preserve
tree.text: The term “Preserve” means the Tallgrass Prairie National Preserve established by section 698u–2 of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

tree.heading: Trust
tree.text: The term “Trust” means the National Park Trust, Inc., a District of Columbia nonprofit corporation, or any successor-in-interest.
